speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: Hello! How are you doing today?

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: I am doing well. How about you?

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: I'm doing pretty well also. Have you heard of the Save the Children charity?

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: That sounds familiar. I know I have heard of it, but I don't know exactly what they do or how they operate.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: They are an organization dedicated to saving children's lives. They are mainly concerned with working in developing countries as those countries cannot do much for their sick children.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: So the organization is focused on medical issues, mainly?

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: Well, mainly sick or hungry children, although they do try to provide children with and education and shelter also.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: Oh wow! I like that they are not focused on only one aspect. When children are in need, it is seldom just one thing that they need. Hunger, poverty, lack of education... these things are all intertwined.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: Exactly! The organization tries to make the children's lives better as a whole. However, this of course does cost money. Have you ever donated money to a charity?

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: Not money, no, but  volunteer work. I used to work with an organization called Food not Bombs that helps feed the homeless, especially those homeless people who are often overlooked by or excluded by food banks and shelters.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: That is incredible! I am always glad to hear people donate their time because it is sometimes worth more than money.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: Thanks! I have always had little money but I always have free time. VOlunteering suits me well.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: That's wonderful. However, while I have your time, would you like to donate just $2 today to help better children's lives through Save the Children?

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: HOnestly, I need the cash. My entire paycheck this week went to bills, and I am wondering how I am going to afford groceries.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: I understand! But, the small donation of $2 can go towards feeding a child for up to a week with our program. You can simply donate the $2 out of your payment for this task.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: I understand, but that payment is going to be used to feed MY children. Sorry.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: No need for hostility! The way I see it, children are children, you are only being selfish.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: Oh no I am sorry. I didn't intend that to be hostile at all! The internet is very bad at conveying mood and such.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: No problem, well I hope YOUR children enjoy feasting while less fortunate children scrap to eat bread crumbs.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: Wow. OKay. YOu don't really know anything about my children or my financial situation.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: You can always donate as little as $.50. This amount could feed a kid for a day or buy a single apple for you.

speaker: A2L0XRNU4SG8UA
text: No, I will use those two dollars to provide a feast for my children.

speaker: AVN1RGGP00USR
text: Okay sir! Hope you sleep well!
